strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Binds headless completion finalization to the current session, drive, closure, root task, root run, and terminal completion evidence owner before checkpoint/event write or replay.
Keeps final Complete closeout tied to the task/run that produced bounded completion evidence rather than a stale or timestamp-selected terminal record.
Keeps completion closeout authority in the Rust runtime and fails closed when the finalization owner tuple cannot be proven.

Records only bounded owner identifiers and fingerprints in finalization checkpoints/events while excluding raw prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout, stderr, commands, environments, paths, raw ledger payloads, and secrets.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for agent_loop, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: A Complete headless drive can be finalized only when the runtime validates the current session/drive/closure/progress/root-task/root-run/terminal-evidence owner tuple; same-owner replay remains idempotent.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: R4.1.1 made Complete evidence fresh, but finalization was still keyed by session/drive/closure and appended its event to the latest terminal task selected by timestamp.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could still close the Golden Journey with a stale or cross-owned finalization boundary after restart, retry, or caller replay confusion.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. R4.2 is distinct from R4.1 closure revalidation, R4.1.1 fresh evidence authority, and M44 registry selection because it binds finalization checkpoint/event ownership.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive finalization behavior changes; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or wrapper surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime now rejects mismatched current progress/evidence owners, rejects conflicting persisted finalization checkpoints, and records finalization events on the validated owner task/run.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless callers can replay or close a completed run without accepting stale/cross-session finalization, improving restart and retry correctness.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the planned R4 finalization ownership P0 blocker and should make R4 closeout eligible after review/merge.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: R4.2 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the R4.2 value gate. Review must confirm this is P0 headless completion finalization ownership remediation, not a wrapper or Mode Pack detour.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive completion finalization validates current session, drive, closure, progress, root task, root run, and terminal completion evidence owner before writing a checkpoint or event
same-owner completion finalization replay remains idempotent
owner mismatch or current progress mismatch fails closed with no finalization checkpoint and no HeadlessRunCompletionFinalized event
persisted finalization checkpoint owner conflict is rejected rather than replayed
finalization event is written to the validated owner task/run rather than a timestamp-selected terminal task
no new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, or preview surface is added
no raw prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout/stderr, commands, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, raw ledger payloads, or secrets are persisted or returned

p0_preemption_rule.effect: New non-remediation capability phases remain superseded while P0 completion/security blockers are open.
